subject: Re: Intermittent missing output observed by NovaCorp — investigation update
messages:
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@novacorp.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: tina.alvarez@novacorp.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intermittent empty completion responses from Redwood API

Hi Marissa,

We're seeing an intermittent condition where batches of calls to Redwood's /v1/completions return no text in the choices array (empty content) for ~0.5% of requests between 2027-04-19 14:03 UTC and 2027-04-19 15:10 UTC. The behaviour looks like the request succeeds (200) but the returned completion is blank. This is affecting our customer chat flow.

Attached is a small log snippet with request_id values and a sanitized sample_request.json. Example request IDs: rq_6f7a9d, rq_6f7aa2, rq_6f7b10.

Can you confirm whether this was a service-side issue or if we should look at our client? We have a heavy retry policy, but these blank responses bypass our fallback.

Thanks,
Ethan
Ethan Cole
Sr. Platform Engineer, NovaCorp

Attachments: nova_sample_logs.txt (text), sample_request.json (json)

Hi Ethan — thanks for the report and the logs. I'm looping in Rishi (infra) and Sean (support lead) to triage.

Quick next steps from our side:
- We'll replay the exact request_ids you provided against the same model and region.
- Check request traces on ingestion, serving, and response serialization.
- Verify there were no delivery/ingress errors or dropped streaming frames.

Can you confirm the SDK version you were using and whether the requests were through our hosted API or a dedicated endpoint? That will help narrow client vs platform.

I'll follow up within 48 hours with findings or a repro.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: NOVACORP blank-completion triage notes (INF-4521)

Team — summary of what I ran this morning against the sample request IDs:

Actions taken
- Replayed request_ids rq_6f7a9d, rq_6f7aa2, rq_6f7b10 from Nova logs against the same model (redwood/open-lite-v2) and region (us-west-2) using our replay harness. Attached repro_harness_output.txt.
- Checked router and ingress logs for the timeframe: no 5xx or obvious gateway drops.
- Examined serving node logs and GPU traces for spikes or OOMs (Rishi did this).
- Validated response serialization step for streaming vs non-streaming clients (no serialization errors recorded).

Findings
- Replays did not reproduce a blank "choices" field. In all replays the model returned non-empty text.
- No anomalies found in the serving node GPU traces: no OOM, kernel failures, or CUDA errors. Rishi: "no infra-level errors in our traces for those timestamps."
- One thing to note: the customer was on SDK v0.9.1 (old). The payloads they sent match our expected schema.
- There were a handful of edge cases earlier this month where transient network interruptions at the client SDK caused truncated websocket frames; those would appear as successful HTTP responses if the client closes the stream early.

Proposed next steps
- Ask Nova to retest on SDK v0.10.x (we believe that includes a websocket resilience fix).
- Keep the ticket INF-4521 open for 14 days for any recurrence; if new evidence appears we'll re-open full investigation.
- Offer a short joint session to reproduce live (I can book 30 minutes with Ethan/Tina).

I'll draft an external closure message once we confirm the recommended SDK update path with Nova.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachment: repro_harness_output.txt

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@novacorp.com>
Cc: Tina Alvarez <tina.alvarez@novacorp.com>, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 28 Apr 2027 16:43:00 -0700
Subject: NOVACORP — investigation update and next steps (INF-4521)

Hi Ethan / Tina,

Thanks again for the example logs and request IDs. We completed an initial investigation and were unable to reproduce the blank-completion behavior on our side. Summary below: 

What we did
- Replayed the exact request IDs you provided against the same model and region; all replays returned text.
- Reviewed ingress/router logs and serving node traces for the reported window; no service-side errors or resource exhaustion events were found.
- Examined response serialization and streaming code paths; no serialization errors were logged.
- Cross-checked request timestamps with our observability (traces linked in INF-4521).

Findings
- We could not find platform-side evidence that would cause a non-empty 200 response to contain an empty completion body.
- We identified that your environment was using SDK v0.9.1; that version had a known websocket resilience edge case that can lead to truncated client-side processing and appear as an empty completion.

Recommendations and next steps
1) Please update to SDK v0.10.3 (release notes: improved streaming buffer handling).
2) If you can reproduce after upgrading, capture the full HTTP/stream frames and attach request_id(s) and a short packet log; we'll escalate and re-run with packet-level traces.
3) We'll keep INF-4521 open for 14 days and monitor. If there are no new reports we'll mark as "no platform finding" and close the ticket.
4) If helpful, we can schedule a 30-minute pairing session to run a live repro — say next Tue or Wed.

If you prefer we can also push a short SDK patch to your CI to test quickly. Let me know which you'd like.

Sorry for the disruption and thanks for the detailed logs — they made triage straightforward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
